prediction_rule.description: For each future draw, rank numbers using the frozen Lottery Forge hybrid score on exactly the previous 104 official Classic draws; select the deterministic top six. No parameter retuning is permitted during this protocol.

checkpoint_correction: Bonferroni across the three pre-declared cumulative checkpoints
primary_metric: cumulative main-number hits versus the exact fixed-pick 6-of-49 hypergeometric null
retuning_policy: No changes to model, window, checkpoints, alpha, or metric until all 104 prospective draws are scored. Any change starts a new protocol id and cannot inherit this protocol's evidence.
seal_policy: Each prediction must target a scheduled future draw, be generated no later than the preceding local calendar date, and be committed to the prospective ledger branch before the outcome exists.
claim_boundary: A prospective prediction is evidence only if it was sealed before the target draw, the protocol and model parameters were fixed in advance, and a pre-declared checkpoint passes its family-wise corrected threshold. Individual hits, near-misses, interim p-values, or anti-crowd rankings do not establish predictive power.
